firstVisitGuide.title: Yeongnyangi will show you
firstVisitGuide.intro: I’ll show you what your reading includes and its price first. Take your time choosing.
firstVisitGuide.profileSpeech: Saju needs your birth details. Choose a profile so I can prepare your reading. For consultations such as tarot that do not need birth details, you can choose a question first.
firstVisitGuide.concernTitle: Tell me what’s on your mind.
firstVisitGuide.concernSpeech: Choose a suggested question or write in your own words. Tell me what is happening and what you most want to know, one thing at a time. We’ll sort it out together.
firstVisitGuide.choiceSpeech: For your first visit, explore the Mackerel reading for one current concern. I’ll show you what your question needs and the price first. You can choose a more in-depth reading later if you want to explore a longer period or several concerns.
firstVisitGuide.profileReady: Your profile is ready. What’s on your mind?
firstVisitGuide.profileQuestion: Whose story shall we explore first?
firstVisitGuide.profileHelp: Choose a saved profile, or create one if you don’t have one. For tarot that does not need birth details, you can go straight to choosing a question.
firstVisitGuide.profileFree: Creating and managing profiles is free. We’ll check the reading’s terms in the next step.
firstVisitGuide.priceHelp: Once you choose a concern, I’ll show you the reading and its price. You are not paying at this step, so take your time.
firstVisitGuide.dailyLink: See how daily check-in readings work
firstVisitGuide.dailyHelp: Daily check-in readings require the Anchovies you have collected. Check how they work before choosing.
